claims_in_paper.claim_text: The UK Strategic Road Network carries approximately one-third of all road traffic and two-thirds of freight tonne-kilometres , yet its adaptive capacity to changing climate conditions is under strain.
synthesised evidence across transport modes and identified precipitation as the weather variable with the most consistent negative effect on road performance.
Traffic performance under adverse weather has been measured by average speed , travel time index , journey-time reliability , and composite resilience scores .
